purpose: Validate real sealed old training-cache compatibility with the new merge interface and two synthetic groups.
scope: One immutable old archive snapshot, source/schema/seed verification, merge and existing trainer input validation only.
resources: Three 4GiB headroom samples before starting; sampled Job limits and 2GiB available-memory floor; bounded time and one attempt.
stop_conditions: Any identity, resource, cleanup or semantic failure after marker stops without retry; a failed preflight reads no cache and does not start an attempt.
boundaries: No failed-panel trace, replay, model, new game, GPU fit, merged archive or sample-level public data.
provenance: Independent subagent advice and review, not WebChat.
